# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 68,034 across 2 platforms (youtube: 58,875, instagram: 9,159).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-11-01.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 84.9%, neutral 7.6%, negative 7.5%.
- youtube: positive 60.7%, neutral 22.2%, negative 17.2%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.487, neutral 0.495, positive 0.505 (spread 0.018).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

- T0: time, agent, think, new - 41,594 posts.
- T5: business, help, build, right - 9,401 posts.
- T3: course, hi, complete, engineer - 1,679 posts.
- T4: chat, gpt, chat gpt, voice - 1,539 posts.
- T2: free, free praise, praise, paid - 1,452 posts.

- Rising: T0: time, agent, think, new (+7.31 pts).
- Rising: T2: free, free praise, praise, paid (+0.06 pts).
- Rising: T3: course, hi, complete, engineer (-0.22 pts).
- Declining: T1: clear, wish, understandable, clear understandable (-0.63 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=7, UMass coherence -0.9074 (more coherent than LDA).
